morbi.headline: Morbi cluster shows premium-led recovery amidst export volume contraction and fraud risks.
what_changed: Varmora Granito reported H1 profit surge driven by premium tile margins, indicating sector recovery for larger players.
Indian ceramic tile exports experienced a steep 46% volume drop during April-July 2026 with a weak FY27 outlook.
A Morbi tile manufacturer faced a credit fraud incident involving a Mumbai buyer defaulting on Rs 44.74 lakh.
stress_signals: Export volume drop of 46% between April and Jul 2026 threatens export-reliant MSMEs [434975bd08e0].
Liquidity and counterparty risk highlighted by a Rs 44.74 lakh credit fraud involving a vanished buyer [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito financial results and 498% H1 profit jump point to recovery driven by premium tiles [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Whether recovery indicators extend from large branded players to smaller MSME vitrified and wall tile producers.
Export volume trends and overseas demand recovery for the remainder of FY27.
Counterparty credit checks, receivables management, and buyer verification protocols for outstation orders.

surat.headline: Surat cluster faces power, cost and labor pressures alongside structural diversification.
what_changed: Surat textile units began producing defence technical textiles and fabrics for the Indian Army [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
Textile markets curtailed Diwali lighting to 5 days amid an electricity crisis and reported 8-hour power cuts [5ae803461fe0, 167f80ff6cdc].
A 50% raw material cost spike prompted a month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
stress_signals: Surat textile market experiencing a Diwali slump due to a 50% raw material cost spike and month-long loom shutdowns affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
Textile units face operational disruptions from 8-hour power cuts and reduced Diwali market lighting [5ae803461fe0, 167f80ff6cdc].
Over 80 embroidery workers detained during protests over wages and holidays, while the embroidery sector impasse enters its third month [7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7].
Diamond exports dropped by 7% amid a polished diamond shipment slump, and a trader defaulted on Rs 70,000 polishing wages [698c779932f2, 975918f112f3].
improvement_signals: Manufacturers commenced production of defence technical textiles for the Indian Army [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
GST Council granted ITC refunds and eased highway checks for Surat textiles [17f0a015a73c].
ICA-GemLab is set to open its first Indian laboratory in Surat [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Monitor debt service and cash flow liquidity for embroidery units facing extended operational deadlocks and labor protests [7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7].
Track loan account performance for loom sheds and weaving units impacted by the month-long shutdown and raw material price spikes [48c63a4e50b6].
